question: Where can I find fast food restaurant inside 50 kilometers as I travel from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ toward Preakness healthcare, Wayne, NJ?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.203042 40.935833)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, 50000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

[3].display_name: Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ
